facts.job_model: How the library schedules work: its job interface and the semantics it assumes.
facts.adapter: How the library's job interface maps onto the shared scheduler interface.

rules.text: Library work that runs on worker threads is submitted through the shared scheduler interface, which observes it during a smoke run.
A ThreadSanitizer build of the composition completes a smoke run with no reports.
A library must not block a worker thread waiting on work that only that worker could run.
